name: Made in Abyss
tagline: A deceptively dark adventure into an endless pit
description: An orphan named Riko dreams of becoming a great cave raider like her mother and solving the mystery of the Abyss. Despite its cute art style, Made in Abyss is a brutally dark fantasy with stunning world-building and emotional gut-punches.
cons: Extremely dark and disturbing at times
seoTitle: Made in Abyss: A Gripping Descent into Darkness | Must-See 2026
